mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_runtime_host_owners(tenant_id,target_kind,target_id,agent_id,session_id,end_user_id,integration_id) VALUES(#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value},#{owner.target.kind},#{owner.target.id},#{owner.target.id},#{owner.sessionRef.sessionId},#{owner.requireUser.value},#{integration}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,agent_id,session_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO nw_system_agent_runtime_capability_sources(tenant_id,session_id,agent_id,end_user_id,input_id,generation,source_data) VALUES(#{owner.sessionRef.tenantId.value},#{owner.sessionRef.sessionId},#{owner.target.id},#{owner.requireUser.value},#{input},#{generation},CAST(#{data} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,session_id,input_id) DO NOTHING
